intro: Convert inches to millimeters with exact precision for engineering drawings, woodworking, and machining tolerances. Because 1 international inch equals exactly 25.4 millimeters, this tool lets you convert decimal to millimeter values or enter fractions like 1 3/8 in directly. For example, two and a half inches in millimeters equals 63.5 mm (2.5 × 25.4). Use the live inches to mm calculator above or jump straight to any benchmark in the inch-to-mm conversion chart below.
alsoWrittenAs: inches to millimetres, in to mm, inch to millimeter, decimal inches to mm, fractional inches to mm

tableRoundingNote: Computed with the exact international factor 1 in = 25.4 mm; decimals shown up to 5 decimal places alongside nearest 1/64" and 1/16" fractions.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Exact NIST Factor vs. Early Rounding Drift
items: The exact conversion factor from Inch to Millimeter is 25.4, fixed by the 1959 International Yard and Pound Agreement (1 in = 25.4 mm).
Approximating 1 inch as 25 mm creates a 1.6% error—over 18 mm off across 45 inches. Always multiply by 25.4 for exact CAD and shop tolerances.

faqs.question: How many millimeters (mm) are in 1 inch (in)?
faqs.answer: There are exactly 25.4 millimeters (mm) in 1 international inch (in). Conversely, 1 millimeter equals approximately 0.03937 inches.

faqs.question: How do I convert inches to millimeters (in to mm)?
faqs.answer: To convert inches to millimeters, multiply the inch measurement by 25.4 (mm = in × 25.4). For example, 8 in × 25.4 = 203.2 mm.

faqs.question: What is two and a half inches in millimeters?
faqs.answer: Two and a half inches (2.5 in) equals exactly 63.5 millimeters (mm), calculated as 2.5 × 25.4 = 63.5 mm.
